rules.source: Texas Data Privacy and Security Act (HB 4, 88th Leg.; Bus. & Com. Code ch. 541), effective July 1, 2024 — https://www.texasattorneygeneral.gov/consumer-protection/file-consumer-complaint/consumer-privacy-rights/texas-data-privacy-and-security-act
rules.retrieved_snippet: Texas AG: gives residents rights to confirm processing, correct, delete, and opt out of targeted advertising, sales and certain profiling; controllers respond within 45 days (extendable 45); AG has exclusive enforcement, no private right of action; GLBA and HIPAA entities exempt.

rules.source: Texas Responsible Artificial Intelligence Governance Act (TRAIGA), HB 149, 89th Leg., effective Jan. 1, 2026 — https://capitol.texas.gov/billlookup/BillSummary.aspx?Bill=HB149&LegSess=89R
rules.retrieved_snippet: Texas Legislature enrolled summary: effective 1-1-26; governs entities deploying AI in Texas, prohibits certain uses (e.g., AI to incite self-harm or crime, social scoring), requires government agencies to disclose AI interaction, AG has exclusive enforcement with 60-day notice, creates a sandbox and AI Council. Penalty amounts not verified against enrolled text.
